final_text: {"status":"CONFLICT","claims":[{"text":"One current policy says personal Dropbox is prohibited for company information classified Internal or above.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account, such as a personal Dropbox, personal Google Drive or personal OneDrive, is prohibited."},{"text":"Another current policy says employees may store Internal information in personal cloud storage when working remotely if the account has multi-factor authentication.","evidence_id":"E4","quote":"Employees may store Internal information in a personal cloud-storage account when working remotely, provided the account is protected with multi-factor authentication.
